Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED]. "had a foot injury that left me limping, and caused issues with my hip and knee. [REDACTED]. The hip mostly is fixed, but the knee got worse and worse."
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 5 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	No acute osseous, ligamentous or meniscal injury.
2.	Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.
3.	Trace joint effusion and trace Baker's cyst.

Aus der Röntgen Voruntersuchung bekannte valgische Fehlstellung am rechten Kniegelenk. Subkortikales Ödem an der lateralen Patellafacette und der artikulierenden femoralen Facette sowie Zysten mit geringem angrenzendem Ödem im medialen Tibiaplateau und in der Eminentia (4/14) und peripher in der medialen Femurkondyle (4/16). Vollständige Chondropathie der lateralen Patellafacette am unteren Patellapol und der lateralen korrespondierenden Femurkondyle mit entsprechendem abschliff und osteophytären Anbauten sowie kortikaler Sklerose. Auch an der medialen retropatellaren Facette deutliche Chondropathie. Auch an den Wangen der Femurkondylen jeweils deutliche Chondropathie mit chondralen Ossifikationen (5/14). Femorotibial im medialen Kompartiment insbesondere am Tibiaplateau großflächige Chondropathie mit fokalen tiefen Läsionen (z. B. 5/22). Lateral weitestgehend erhaltener Knorpelbelag mit einzelnen oberflächlichen Läsionen insbesondere peripher (5/9). Der Außenmeniskus an der Vorderwurzel deutlich signalalteriert (5/24). Der Innenmeniskus intakt. Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Moderater Gelenkerguss. Synovia gering verdickt. Umgebende Muskulatur und Weichteile unauffällig.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs  normaldir. Medial menisküs posteriorunda kök düzeyinde yırtık ile uyumlu bütünlük kaybı mevcuttur. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Retropatellar ve femoral kartilajda kondromalazi ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Distal kuadriseps ve diğer patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Diz eklem aralığı ve suprapatellar bursada effüzyon izlendi.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Sonuç: Diz eklem aralığı ve suprapatellar bursada effüzyon , kondromalazi, medial menisküs posterior hornunda kök yırtığı, ACL'de mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri.

Uznapredovale gonartrotske promjene.
Promijenjena morfologija medijalnog meniska, može odgovarati stanju po ranijoj rupturi prednjeg
roga i trupa na bazi degenerativnih promjena.
Degenerativne promjene lateralnog meniska.
Potpuna ruptura pregdnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Intraosealna ganglion cista na mjestu tibijalnog hvatišta stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Vidi se manja količina slobodne tekućine u suprapatelarnoj burzi.
Denudacija medijalnog dijela hrskavice medijalnog kondila femura u sklopu opisanih gonartrotskih
promjena.
Nešto manje izražen koštani edem u području cirkumferencije medijalnog kondila femura.
Prati se Bakerova cista koja pokazuje komunikacijski sinus sa stražnjom poplitealnom jamom.

> Osteoarthritis of knee joint with spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at lateral patellofemoral joint with grade 3-4 chondromalacia and tiny subchondral cysts over femoral trochlea.
  Small cystic change and spur formation over tibial intercondylar eminance
> Linear signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus, with suspicious of extending into the surface of anterior horn of lateral meniscus, in favor of degeneration of meniscus and R/O  tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
> The contour of ACL is in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis; retrocruciate synovial recess.
> An oval hypointensity focus in subchondral region of medial femoral condyle on T1WI and F/S T2WI, R/O bone island. (Srs/Img: [ID]/16)
> Mild fat stranding over anterior suprapatellar fat pad, maybe due to mild inflammation.
  Mild tendinosis of quadricepse tendon.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right knee, more severe at lateral patellofemoral joint with grade 4 chondral injury and suspicious of lateral sublucation .
2. Synovitis of right knee and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
3. Degeneration of meniscus and R/O tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
4. Grade 1 injury of ACL
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation
